name: Small services company (format example only)
summary: This file shows the format and is deliberately tiny. It is illustrative, not researched, and every number in it is a tier C placeholder. The company sells consulting projects to business clients, bills them monthly for the hours worked and pays its staff's travel costs. It has a delivery division that does the client work and a finance department that bills clients, pays expenses and closes the books each month. A real organisation file has every division and department, dozens of roles and at least thirty processes, each linked to the processes and outside parties it exchanges work with.

units.name: Finance
units.purpose: Bills clients, pays staff expenses and suppliers, closes the books.

systems.name: ERP general ledger, billing and payments

business_objects.name: Approved timesheet
business_objects.description: Hours worked per consultant per project per week.

business_objects.name: Expense claim
business_objects.description: A consultant's claim for travel costs with receipts.

business_objects.name: Client invoice
business_objects.description: The monthly bill for hours and rebillable expenses.

business_objects.name: Ledger postings
business_objects.description: Journal lines posted to the general ledger.

external_parties.name: Client
external_parties.description: A business that buys consulting projects.

process_map.name: Deliver project work and record time
process_map.description: Consultants do the client work, record hours against the project each week and their engagement manager approves the timesheet. Late or wrongly coded timesheets hold up billing.

process_map.name: Reimburse employee expenses
process_map.description: A consultant submits a travel claim with receipts, the engagement manager approves it, an expense auditor checks it against policy and it is paid in the weekly run. Missing receipts send claims back.

process_map.name: Bill clients
process_map.description: At month end a billing specialist turns approved timesheets and rebillable expenses into a draft invoice, the engagement manager reviews it and it is sent to the client. Disputed hours cause credit notes.

process_map.name: Close the books each month
process_map.description: Finance cuts off postings, accrues unbilled work and unpaid expenses, reconciles the bank and produces the monthly results for the partners. It depends on billing and expenses finishing on time.

assumptions: Every number in this file is a placeholder to show the format.
